WORKFORCE
Our large, global workforce plays an important role in our operations, supporting the execution of our flexible off-price business model as described above, including the management of a rapidly changing merchandise mix, throughout our global organization. As of the end of FY24, we employed approximately 349,000 Associates worldwide, including full-time, part-time, temporary, and seasonal Associates. We offer positions at a variety of levels in our stores, distribution and fulfillment centers, and offices, as well as many opportunities for Associates to grow and advance. We seek to foster a strong, supportive, and inclusive culture so that Associates at all levels of TJX feel welcome in the Company, valued for their contributions, and engaged with our business mission. We are highly focused on teaching and mentoring to support the success of our Associates, and we believe these efforts, along with our total rewards strategies, help to promote retention, teamwork, and collaboration across our workforce.

FY24 BUSINESS REVIEW
Our FY24 results, highlighted below, reflect the continued strong execution of our business plans and growth strategies. Total consolidated annual sales surpassed $50 billion with consolidated comparable store sales* growth of 5% driven by increases in customer transactions across each of our divisions. Overall apparel comparable store sales were strong throughout FY24 and home comparable store sales improved significantly versus FY23 as they accelerated in the second half of the year. During FY24, we successfully increased our pre-tax profit margin, generated very strong cash flow, and expanded our global store base. In FY24, we also reinvested in our business to support our growth plans while simultaneously returning significant value to shareholders. FY24 was a 53-week year, and FY23 was a 52-week year.

BOARD INDEPENDENCE
Under our Corporate Governance Principles, at least two-thirds of the members of our Board should be independent. An independent director is one who the Board has affirmatively determined has no material relationship with TJX (either directly or as a partner, shareholder, or officer of an organization that has a relationship with the Company). To assist it in making its independence determination, the Board has adopted categorical independence standards in our Corporate Governance Principles that are based on the independence standards required by the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE)
